campaign_wide_preflight.reason: P008 already owns agency/husbandry/clearance/disbursement administrative readiness and explicitly models local information, while P137 owns generic private/regional institutional topology. P021 and P067 cover governance and equipment-provider lifecycle. Only local port-call service-bundle continuity and local-information freshness survive as new categories; most other service-order, funding, substitution, scope and restoration states are refinements or duplicates.

campaign_wide_reclassification.reason: Administrative readiness, funding/authorization, agent scope, provider substitution, partial readiness, change notification, completion confidence, exception ownership and generic restoration substantially repeat P008/P137. Two port-call-specific categories and five bounded refinements remain useful.

method_observation_reason: P138 is deliberately a low-novelty validation against P008/P137 and exposes no new campaign-process defect. It supports stopping deeper private/regional port-call decomposition rather than creating another method observation.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only structural private/regional port-call service-bundle orientation. Campaign-wide comparison retains only two new local-service categories and five refinements; no named provider, port, tariff, form, contract, procedure, incident or current-status fact is established.
